errors.text: The proposed magnetic cDFT/MTP mechanism is imported from Fe-Al and is not supported for TaVCrW; the target instead finds high-temperature magnetic effects negligible.

The perturbation method is left ambiguous and even described as thermodynamic integration from a reference state, rather than clearly reconstructing direct MTP-to-DFT free-energy perturbation based on low energy-difference variance.
The hypothesis omits the target's essential electronic-excitation and solid-state short-range-order free-energy contributions.
The predicted performance metrics are unsupported and do not reconstruct the demonstrated 80% resource saving, approximately 20-fold speedup, or sub-0.5 meV/atom free-energy agreement.
